title: Great bikes super guide in Oscar
text: Oscar was a truly excellent guide. His super friendly and welcoming manner made the whole tour a lot of fun. We learnt loads of interesting facts and enjoyed a super safe and enjoyable whizz around Madrid. Highly recommend!
author: Adventurer33London

title: Beautiful, interesting and cozy bike ride
text: Super experience with Mario! He has told us a lot about the interesting history of Granada. Beautiful bike ride with great views. And great tips for restaurants. Highly recommended! And Mario is a nice guy 😉
author: HannekeSchut

title: Good guided bike tour by Mario
text: We booked a guided bike tour. Our guide, Mario, gave us a private tour because we were the only ones. He showed us the beautiful spots as well as hidden gems. He knows a lot about history. Highly recommended.

title: A great way to experience Granada.
text: An e-bike tour is a great way to see Granada.  Our guide, Marta, was an excellent storyteller who explained Granada’s rich history in detail and color.   She was very patient with our many questions and we had many chances to stop for photos along the way.
author: Lisa_C

title: Great E-bike ride through Granada!

title: Granada bike tour
text: What a wonderful bike tour!  Our guide, Mario, was amazing.  He provided a lot of history and information on not only Granada and the surrounding area, but also Spain.  I would highly recommend using Mario!
author: Jamie_B

title: Joyful experience
text: Joyful and paradise way to know Granada. Mario very pleasant and knowledgeable of history, and the bikes in perfect condition. In love with this beautiful city. Super recommended!
author: Roberto_Z

title: Informative, beautiful, and adventurous
text:
It was a beautiful, comprehensive tour of Granada and the city’s history which provided a great introduction to the city as a whole. Plus, the informal, easy-going feel of the tour made me feel much more like a local than a tourist. The guides had great English and I would strongly recommend this tour.

The only thing to consider is whether or not you are willing to manage a bit of stress navigating the busy, narrow streets on bike. Going uphill was hard at times, so I would suggest this tour for more adventurous travelers.
